projectName: StaffTime — Workforce OS for Shopify POS

tasks.title: Project setup
tasks.description: Scaffold Shopify app, configure repo, dependencies, and environment.

tasks.title: Shopify app foundation
tasks.description: React Router app shell, auth, scopes, navigation, and shop bootstrap.

tasks.title: Workforce data model
tasks.description: Prisma schema for employees, locations, shifts, time entries, breaks, approvals, audit logs.

tasks.title: POS clock workflow
tasks.description: POS smart grid tile and modal for PIN/QR verify, clock in/out, and breaks.

tasks.title: Time tracking engine
tasks.description: Worked hours, paid hours, unpaid breaks, overtime, and summaries.

tasks.title: Scheduling
tasks.description: Manager shift creation and upcoming shift visibility.

tasks.title: Attendance dashboard
tasks.description: Live working, on break, late, absent, and upcoming shift views with auto-refresh.

tasks.title: Payroll export
tasks.description: CSV export for timesheets and labor cost fields.

tasks.title: Approval workflow
tasks.description: Missed punch requests with manager approve/reject and audit trail.

tasks.title: Reporting
tasks.description: Daily attendance metrics, labor cost snapshot, and timesheet summaries.

tasks.title: Verification and anti-buddy-punching
tasks.description: GPS geofence, photo verification, and device registration.

tasks.title: Offline sync
tasks.description: Queue POS clock events offline and sync when connectivity returns.

tasks.title: Notifications
tasks.description: Email, SMS, and push alerts for shifts, approvals, and reminders.

tasks.title: Documentation and launch readiness
tasks.description: README, setup docs, tests, production hosting, and App Store prep.

tasks.title: MVP hardening and QA
tasks.description: Dev config, deploy, POS Android testing, timer sync, PIN uniqueness, and dashboard live updates.

tasks.title: Employee management UX
tasks.description: Expanded staff profiles, edit staff, change PIN, show QR code, deactivate staff.
